title: Rational design and synthesis of Co(ii), Ni(ii) and Cu(ii) complexes bearing 1,2,4-triazole scaffold for biological applications.
authors: Hassoon, Azza A; Abulkhair, Hamada S; Ashour, Ranim H; Abdelsamea, Mariam M; Abdullah, Haidy O; Eldesoky, Mona A; Shaban, Ali R; John, Philopater; Ghaith, Eslam A
one_liner_zh: 该文合成三唑金属配合物并做抗菌抗癌活性、DNA结合实验及分子对接，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作但对象为小分子金属配合物而非TF-DNA体系，方法仅常规对接，深度不足。
abstract: The chemistry of 1,2,4-triazole-incorporating compounds and their metal complexes has attracted widespread attention due to their potential therapeutic activities. Therefore, this paper presents the synthesis, characterization, biological studies, and theoretical molecular docking evaluation of 4-amino-3-hydrazino-5-mercapto-1,2,4-triazole (AHMT) and its Co(ii), Ni(ii), and Cu(ii) complexes. The proposed structures were confirmed by elemental and spectroscopic analyses, yielding trans-N(2)S(2) in an equatorial arrangement within an octahedral geometry. Numerous biological studies have been conducted on AHMT, Co(ii)-AHMT, Ni(ii)-AHMT, and Cu(ii)-AHMT. The synthesized scaffolds have been screened for their antibacterial activity against various bacterial and fungal species. Notably, Ni(ii)-AHMT is more potent than the other hybrids. Indeed, the cytotoxic activity of the synthesized hybrids was assessed against four human cancer cell lines: HePG2, MCF-7, HeP-2, and HeLa. The findings revealed that Ni(ii)-AHMT has the most toxicity with IC(50) values of 8.70 +/- 0.5 microM and 9.72 +/- 0.7 microM against MCF-7 and HeLa cell lines, respectively. The enhanced antimicrobial and anticancer activities of the metal complexes relative to the free AHMT ligand are attributed to Tweedy's chelation theory, which explains that reduced metal polarity increases lipophilicity and membrane penetration. Mechanistic studies revealed that Ni(ii)-AHMT induces cell death primarily via apoptosis and causes prominent G0/G1 cell-cycle arrest in MCF-7 cells. DNA-binding assays of the synthesized compounds were performed. Additionally, the activity of superoxide dismutase (SOD) in the compounds has also been evaluated using the NBT assay. The free ligand AHMT and its nickel complex Ni(ii)-AHMT demonstrate notable radical-scavenging capacity, achieving 75.8% and 70.2% inhibition, respectively, compared to the reference antioxidant l-ascorbic acid (78.2%). Molecular docking experiments were conducted to understand the binding interactions of AHMT and its metal complexes with DNA, beta-lactamase, and human serum albumin. The docking simulations were consistent with the in vitro findings and suggested that Ni(ii)-AHMT is a potential DNA groove binder and a potent antimicrobial candidate that merits further in vivo investigations.
abstract_zh: 含1,2,4-三唑的化合物及其金属配合物的化学因其潜在的治疗活性而受到广泛关注。因此，本文介绍了4-氨基-3-肼基-5-巯基-1,2,4-三唑（AHMT）及其Co(ii)、Ni(ii)和Cu(ii)配合物的合成、表征、生物学研究及理论分子对接评价。所提出的结构通过元素分析和光谱分析得到确认，在八面体几何中呈现赤道排列的反式-N(2)S(2)构型。对AHMT、Co(ii)-AHMT、Ni(ii)-AHMT和Cu(ii)-AHMT进行了多项生物学研究。合成的骨架已针对多种细菌和真菌物种筛选其抗菌活性。值得注意的是，Ni(ii)-AHMT比其他杂合物更有效。确实，评估了合成杂合物对四种人类癌细胞系HePG2、MCF-7、HeP-2和HeLa的细胞毒性活性。结果表明，Ni(ii)-AHMT具有最强的毒性，对MCF-7和HeLa细胞系的IC(50)值分别为8.70 +/- 0.5微摩尔和9.72 +/- 0.7微摩尔。金属配合物相对于游离AHMT配体增强的抗菌和抗癌活性归因于Tweedy的螯合理论，该理论解释了金属极性降低会增加亲脂性和膜穿透性。机制研究表明，Ni(ii)-AHMT主要通过凋亡诱导细胞死亡，并在MCF-7细胞中引起显著的G0/G1细胞周期阻滞。对合成化合物进行了DNA结合实验。此外，还使用NBT实验评估了化合物中超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）的活性。游离配体AHMT及其镍配合物Ni(ii)-AHMT表现出显著的自由基清除能力，分别达到75.8%和70.2%的抑制率，而参考抗氧化剂l-抗坏血酸为78.2%。进行了分子对接实验，以理解AHMT及其金属配合物与DNA、β-内酰胺酶和人血清白蛋白的结合相互作用。对接模拟与体外结果一致，并表明Ni(ii)-AHMT是一种潜在的DNA沟槽结合剂和有前景的抗菌候选物，值得进一步的体内研究。
